src/metrics/smoothing.rs.description: RollingAverage struct uses u16 values with configurable window_size. Factory methods: three_second() (window=3), thirty_second() (window=30). Used for power smoothing. Need ten_second() for cadence.

src/metrics/calculator.rs.description: MetricsCalculator processes power through RollingAverage instances (power_3s, power_30s). Cadence is currently stored raw without smoothing. AggregatedMetrics holds power_3s_avg/power_30s_avg but only raw cadence.
